identity_held_roles.title: R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager, Project Management
identity_held_roles.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

**What You Will Experience In This Position**

The R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager will be a strategic and hands-on leader who drives on-time delivery and best practices for our new product introduction (NPI) programs within our Data Solutions business. This role will lead, coach and mentor a team of project and program managers to ensure alignment with business goals through effective portfolio and process management. The manager will work closely with business unit leaders, product managers, and engineering leaders to drive and improve on-time delivery and cross-functional collaboration for our portfolio of NPI programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development:**
Lead, mentor and inspire a high-performing, global project management team specializing in NPI Program execution. Develop a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and empower the team to drive excellence in project delivery.

**NPI Execution and Delivery:**
Oversee end-to-end execution of projects, ensuring on-time delivery, within scope and on budget while maintaining high quality outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**
Partner closely with engineering, product management, integrated supply chain, manufacturing and operations teams to ensure alignment of project priorities, resources, and timelines, facilitating seamless execution of programs.

**Resource Allocation:**
Optimize resource planning and allocation across projects, balancing capacity dynamically to meet changing business priorities and ensure effective utilization

**Portfolio Management:**
Collaborate with key partners to drive the selection and prioritization of NPI projects, connected to our strategic objectives and business goals.

**Continuous Improvement**
: Own and evolve the NPI phase-gate process to ensure consistent and efficient product development lifecycle execution. Drive continuous evaluation and enhancement of our project management processes, tools and methodologies to improve efficiency and scalability of programs.

**Performance & Reporting:**
Define and track KPIs to measure project health and business impact. Lead monthly business reviews to communicate progress, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.

**You Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Ideally 10+ years of proven experience in NPI or PMO leadership roles, preferably in data or technology-driven environments of which 2+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams
* Proven record of leading large-scale, complex projects and driving successful product introductions
* Proficiency in demonstrating expertise in PMO practices, methodologies, tools and processes.
* Outstanding ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive results in a matrixed organization.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and decision-making abilities to drive efficiency and optimize project outcomes.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or engineering focused organizations

**We Have**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
* nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
* Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.
* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work
* We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
* Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

* Innovative & adaptable
* Dedicated to absolute integrity
* Focused on the customer first
* Respectful and team oriented
* Optimistic and energizing
* Accountable for performance
* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Pay Transparency**

nVent’s pay scale is based on the expected range of base pay for this job and the employee’s work location. Employee pay within this range will be based on a combination of factors including knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, education, and performance. Where federal, state, or local minimum wage requirements exist, employee pay will comply.

**Compensation Range**

$123,500.00 - $229,500.00

Depending on the position offered, employee may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as annual incentives.

**Benefit Overview**

At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.
* Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection.

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

identity_held_roles.title: Quality Improvement Director
identity_held_roles.description:
***POSITION PURPOSE:***

The Director of Quality Improvement operates under the leadership and direction of the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and Chief Operating Officer (COO). The CMO maintains direct clinical oversight of clinical quality improvement activities and regulatory quality programs. The Director of Quality Improvement provides organization-wide leadership for EVCHC's quality improvement program. The Director establishes the quality strategy in partnership with executive, clinical, operational and compliance leaders; converts organizational goals and regulatory requirements into measurable work plans; and leads improvement efforts that strengthen patient outcomes, safety, access, equity and care experience. The Director is accountable for reliable quality data, required clinical quality reporting, continuous improvement methods, Patient Centered Medical Home recognition, and the performance of the Quality Improvement Department.

 

***MAJOR POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS:***

**Quality Strategy and Governance**

* Lead the development, implementation and annual evaluation of EVCHC's organization-wide Quality Improvement and Quality Assurance Plan in alignment with the strategic plan, clinical standards and applicable Health Center Program requirements.

* Establish annual quality priorities, measures, targets, owners and timelines with executive and clinical leadership. Monitor progress and recommend corrective action when performance does not meet established goals.

* Lead or support the Quality Improvement Committee and related workgroups. Prepare agendas, dashboards, meeting materials, decisions and follow-up reports for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, as requested.

* Advise executive leaders on emerging quality risks, performance trends, resource needs and opportunities to improve care delivery across sites and service lines.

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, patient safety and learning throughout the organization.

**Department Leadership**

* Direct the work of the Quality Improvement Department, including recruitment, onboarding, supervision, coaching, performance evaluation, workload assignment and staff development.

* Develop departmental goals, staffing plans, procedures and budgets that support timely completion of quality priorities and reporting obligations.

* Set clear expectations for the accuracy, timeliness and usability of analyses, audits, reports and improvement support provided by the department.

* Build effective working relationships with clinical care teams, Operations, Information Technology, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Behavioral Health, Dental and other departments involved in quality outcomes.

**Quality Measurement and Reporting**

* Oversee the collection, validation, analysis and submission of clinical quality measures and required reports, including Uniform Data System measures, population health platforms transition and readiness, HEDIS and payer measures, grant measures and internal quality indicators.

* Develop and maintain executive, provider, site and service-line dashboards that show current performance, trends, disparities, targets and improvement actions.

* Track provider and care-team performance, identify variation and care gaps, and provide leaders with actionable information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data-use standards.

* Establish data-validation controls and documentation so that quality reports can be reconciled to source systems and used as an organization-wide source of truth. Partnering with Director of Data and IT operations for oversight on data governance committee.

* Present quality findings in clear written and verbal reports to the Board, executive leadership, managers, providers, staff, health plans and external reviewers, as appropriate.

**Performance Improvement**

* Lead Plan Do Study Act cycles, root-cause analyses and other structured improvement methods from problem definition through implementation, evaluation and sustainment.

* Partner with clinical and operational leaders to improve preventive care, chronic disease outcomes, access, continuity, patient experience, care coordination, documentation and other priority measures.

* Translate data findings into practical workflow changes, training, decision support, audit tools and accountability processes that can be sustained across sites.

* Evaluate improvement results, identify lessons learned and spread effective practices to other care teams, programs or locations when appropriate **Regulatory Readiness and Patient Safety**

* Lead the quality components of Patient Centered Medical Home recognition and renewal, including evidence collection, workflow assessment, documentation, staff education and sustainment of recognized practices alongside Director of compliance.

* Partner with Compliance Director, Risk Management, clinical leadership and Operations on quality-related readiness for HRSA operational site visits, FTCA deeming and risk-management activities, health plan audits, accreditation reviews and other external assessments.

* Support corrective action plans with the Director of Compliance arising from audits, quality reviews, safety events or regulatory findings. Define measures, monitor completion and verify that corrective actions are effective and sustained.

* Analyze trends in patient safety events, grievances and quality-of-care concerns with the appropriate leaders while protecting confidentiality and following reporting requirements.

* Maintain organized records of quality plans, committee actions, reports, audits, improvement projects and supporting evidence required for oversight and external review.

**Clinical Analytics and Health Information Technology**

* Direct the clinical analytics program and define reporting requirements that support clinical decision-making, population health management and performance improvement.

* Partner with Information Technology and system vendors to improve data extraction, interfaces, registries, care guidelines, clinical decision support, templates and reporting tools used for quality measurement.

* Lead data-governance practices for quality information, including measure definitions, ownership, validation, access, change control and resolution of reporting discrepancies.

* Assess the quality and workflow impact of new digital tools and automation used in clinical or quality processes and recommend safeguards, testing and performance monitoring before broad implementation.

* Recommend redesign of workflows affected by the electronic health record, patient portal, population health platforms and other clinical information systems.

**Organizational Responsibilities**

* Participate in executive, management, clinical and staff meetings related to quality priorities and organizational performance.

* Maintain current knowledge of FQHC quality requirements, clinical quality measures, health plan expectations and recognized improvement practices.

* Protect patient, employee and organizational information and comply with HIPAA, confidentiality, cybersecurity and records-management requirements.

* Perform other job-related duties as assigned within the scope of the position.

***POSITION REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:***

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in public health, health care administration, nursing, health sciences, informatics or a related field is required. A master's degree is preferred.

* At least five years of progressive experience in health care quality improvement, population health, clinical analytics or health care program management is required, including at least three years of supervisory or department leadership experience.

* Experience in a Federally Qualified Health Center, community health center or other safety-net setting is strongly preferred.

* Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects and preparing quality reports for executives, governing boards, health plans or regulatory agencies is required.

* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality, Lean or Six Sigma certification, or comparable quality-improvement training is preferred.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Working knowledge of continuous quality improvement methods, patient safety practices, clinical quality measurement, health equity and population health management.

* Knowledge of HRSA Health Center Program expectations, Uniform Data System reporting, HEDIS measures, Patient Centered Medical Home standards and payer quality programs is strongly preferred.

* Advanced ability to collect, validate, analyze and present health care data and to translate findings into operational decisions and improvement plans.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience using electronic health records, population health platforms, data visualization tools or clinical reporting applications. Experience with NextGen or comparable systems is preferred.

* Strong leadership, project management, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build accountability across departments .

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet reporting deadlines, exercise sound judgment and communicate sensitive performance information professionally.

* Demonstrated commitment to serving medically underserved communities and reducing disparities in access, care and health outcomes.

***WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL/MENTAL ABILITIES AND PROCESSES:***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

 

* Work is performed primarily in an office and health center environment and requires regular travel among EVCHC sites and occasional travel to meetings or trainings.

* The position requires extended periods of sitting and computer use, as well as standing, walking, bending, reaching, speaking, hearing and seeing sufficient to perform assigned duties.

* The employee must be able to communicate clearly, review detailed reports, maintain concentration, manage competing deadlines and work effectively in shared office and clinical environments.

* The employee must be able to lift and carry materials and equipment weighing up to 20 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

DOE: $125,000 - $148,824 Annually

Please apply to this position with your current resume.

Principals only. Recruiters, please do not contact this job posting.

*EOE is the Law. It is the stated policy of EVCHC to conform to all the laws, statutes, and regulations concerning equal employment opportunities and affirmative action. We strongly encourage women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans to apply to all of our job openings. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, age, disability status, Genetic Information & Testing, Family & Medical Leave, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We prohibit Retaliation against individuals who bring forth any complaint, orally or in writing, to the employer or the government, or against any individuals who assist or participate in the investigation of any complaint or otherwise oppose discrimination.*

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

identity_held_roles.title: Sr. Director, Additive Manufacturing Systems Engineering
identity_held_roles.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------

Hadrian is building an additive manufacturing capability that runs as part of an autonomous factory, not as a room full of printers. The hard problem is not any single machine, material, or line of code. It is making all of them behave as one system. Systems engineering is the glue that holds that system together, and this role owns the glue.

The Senior Director leads three engineering functions, materials and process engineering, hardware engineering, and software engineering, and is accountable for the digital backbone that binds them to each other and to applications engineering: the architecture, interfaces, and data that connect Hadrian’s Opus platform to cutting-edge additive manufacturing equipment, add automation where it makes sense, fuse sensor data into the part record, and turn a collection of parts into a full, integrated digital manufacturing system built around additive.

The measure of success is not three strong teams. It is one manufacturing system that a customer part flows through, from design intent to qualified hardware, with every decision and every data point captured along the way.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Architect the system.** Define and control the end-to-end architecture for additive at Hadrian: requirements, interfaces, data model, and acceptance criteria that hold across multiple equipment platforms, modalities, and sites. Treat the factory as the product.
* **Build the digital backbone.** Connect additive equipment, peripherals, and inspection assets to Opus with the same discipline a semiconductor fab applies to connecting tools to the host: standardized state models, telemetry, event streams, and data contracts, with security and configuration control built in.
* **Fuse the sensors.** Bring in-situ monitoring, machine telemetry, environmental data, and downstream inspection into one correlated record per part, then move from monitoring to data-driven release and, where it is justified, closed-loop control.
* **Automate where it pays.** Lead automation across additive cells (material and powder handling, build changeover, part removal and depowdering, post-processing flow, robotics, controls, and safety) with a written case for each: safety, repeatability, and data capture first; labor second. Never automate an unstable process.
* **Lead the three functions as one.** Set standards, priorities, and cadence for materials and process, hardware, and software engineering. Resolve conflicts between them at the architecture level, not the escalation level.
* **Own the applications engineering interface.** With the Head of Applications Engineering, define what a production-ready hand-off looks like, publish the process capability and design-rule data applications engineers build to, and close the loop from floor results back into design guidance.
* **Industrialize the equipment.** Through the hardware engineering leader, own factory and site acceptance, commissioning, reliability (preventive maintenance, spares, MTBF/MTTR), and configuration-controlled modification and upgrade of additive systems, and lead the technical relationships with equipment partners that unlock deeper integration. The machine-level depth lives in that team; the standards and the outcomes live here.
* **Design for the factory.** Partner with Factory Development and Factory Automation on cell and site design: material flow, capacity, simulation, utilities, and the path to lights-out operation for additive.
* **Build quality in.** Make the system itself the evidence: traceability, data integrity, and process control that stand up to AS9100 audits and customer qualification without a separate paper trail.
* **Be the additive voice in Hadrian’s platform.** Carry additive requirements into Core Engineering and the Opus roadmap, and bring platform capability back to the floor.
* **Hire, develop, and retain.** Build a leadership bench under you, set a high technical bar, and make Hadrian the place the best additive systems engineers in the country want to work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a physical science; an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 12+ years in advanced manufacturing, with real depth in at least three of these six domains: factory design and industrial automation; semiconductor or other high-reliability capital-equipment engineering; manufacturing software and data systems; materials science and process engineering; quality systems in regulated industries; sensing, process monitoring, and sensor fusion.
* 5+ years leading engineering teams, including leading through managers and building at least one function from the ground up.
* Production experience with metal laser powder bed fusion, as a user of the equipment, a developer of it, or both.
* Has led the integration of complex equipment into factory-level software (manufacturing execution, equipment host, or data platforms), including requirements, interface standards, and acceptance criteria.
* Has taken at least one production automation or capital-equipment program (robotic cells, material handling, or equipment with safety systems and controls) from concept through commissioning in a regulated environment (aerospace and defense, semiconductor, medical, or similar), and has owned the reliability of production equipment afterward.
* Fluent across the stack: can review a process flow, a data schema, a metallurgical cross-section, and a controls narrative in the same meeting, and knows which one is lying.
* Has worked as a true peer to a customer-facing or design function, with a record of building clean interfaces rather than absorbing the other team.
* Willing to travel up to 20%, including to Hadrian sites and international partners. Must meet the ITAR requirements below.

**What Will Set You Apart**
---------------------------

* Ph.D. in materials science, mechanical engineering, systems engineering or a related discipline.
* Semiconductor capital-equipment background: equipment-to-host integration, tool matching, fleet data, fault detection and statistical process control at scale.
* Equipment-maker experience developing or launching metal additive systems (new product introduction, cost-productivity trades, design reviews) in addition to user-side experience.
* In-situ monitoring and sensor fusion implemented in production, with data-driven release or closed-loop control.
* Factory design: material flow planning, discrete-event simulation, and highly automated or lights-out operations.
* AS9100 and customer qualification pathways; familiarity with AM specifications (ASTM F42, ISO/ASTM 529xx, SAE AMS 7xxx series).
* Budget or P&L ownership of a capital-intensive program, with a record of making the build-versus-buy and automate-versus-wait calls well.
* Modern software fluency: APIs, event streaming, OT/IT architecture, industrial interoperability standards (OPC UA, MTConnect), and cloud data platforms.

**Compensation**
----------------

For this role, the target salary range is $300,000 - $350,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**Benefits for Full-time Employees**
------------------------------------

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
 
 401k
* Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

**Use of AI in hiring**
-----------------------

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

**Consideration of Criminal History**

identity_held_roles.description:
**Position Overview:**

As the Regional Senior Manager of Post Production/IQR, you will have the unique opportunity to partner closely with several different teams at multiple sites (including IC leadership, reconditioning, and support teams) to drive the strategy behind the development and deployment of Post Production & Quality programs, as well as manage continued performance of internal and external vendors. We are looking for a resourceful self-starter who will set the tone for the successful and fast-paced growth of our Inspection Centers. The Regional Senior Manager of Post Production/IQR role will be heavily focused on leading our teams to effectively close operational gaps and establishing standardized practices that will drive exceptional quality.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Driving successful execution amongst our Post Production teams by effectively leading and developing team members and creating and implementing new processes and systems.
* Identifying issues or roadblocks to execution and quickly taking action to problem solve and implement effective solutions across a large and quickly evolving platform.
* Providing clear direction and necessary support to ensure operational gaps are being closed in a timely manner.
* Working with key business partners to develop systems, metrics, reporting, and staffing models for our Post Production processes and teams.
* Effectively leading and developing onsite personnel at third-party production locations.
* Managing quality of internal and external vendors responsible for producing units for Carvana.
* Establishing effective working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Creating and successfully executing large-scale change management initiatives and new process rollouts.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What the job requires:**

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

* Minimum of 8 years of leadership, people development, and operations experience
* Experience working in a Lean Manufacturing environment
* Experience developing effective and scalable operating systems and processes
* Proven track record of production process improvement and innovation
* Proven track record of managing complex change across large teams
* Proven track record of leading and developing others
* Proven ability to obtain project deliverables and company metrics
* Strong analytical thinking and organizational skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; Ability to learn quickly and transfer knowledge
* Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance
* Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to travel up to 80% (multi site responsibility)
* Ability to provide valuable and actionable feedback
* Proficient computer skills
* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation Range: $120K-$140K annually

**Legal stuff** 
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. 
Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
existing_roles.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
  
  
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
  
  
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

#BuildingEnvelope
  
  
**Amrize is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**
*We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.*

We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. existing_roles.description:
**Job Title**
- Executive Director, Quality Assurance
  
  
**Department**
- Quality Assurance
  
  
**Work Location**
- Cranbury NJ (On-site)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Head of U.S. Quality provides strategic, scientific, and operational leadership for Quality Assurance and Quality Control across U.S. operations. The role is accountable for maintaining an effective, risk-based Quality Management System and ensuring that research, development, clinical, CMC, and manufacturing activities comply with applicable global regulations, industry standards, company policies, and client expectations. The position drives quality excellence, inspection readiness, organizational capability, and continuous improvement, with particular emphasis on biologics, commercial manufacturing, and complex CDMO operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Quality Leadership
  
  

* Provide strategic and scientific leadership for the U.S. quality organization and execute the global Quality strategy in alignment with company standards, policies, and business objectives.
* Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions supporting R&D, Clinical, CMC, technology transfer, manufacturing, and commercial operations.
* Embed quality considerations into strategic planning, new services, product development, site improvement, and organizational growth decisions.
* Serve as the senior Quality representative with clients, partners, regulatory authorities, external auditors, and industry forums.

Quality Management System and Compliance
  
  

* Establish, govern, monitor, and continuously improve a robust, risk-based Quality Management System and related procedural framework.
* Provide oversight of change control, deviations, investigations, CAPA, quality risk management, document control, training, validation, data trending, and management review.
* Ensure controlled documentation, including SOPs, master and executed batch records, validation protocols and reports, and technical reports, is accurate, current, and compliant.
* Identify and implement systemic improvements based on compliance trends, quality metrics, inspection outcomes, industry benchmarks, and emerging regulatory expectations.

Regulatory and Inspection Readiness
  
  

* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable GxP and cGMP requirements, including FDA, EMA, NMPA/CFDA, ICH, USP, EP, and Chinese Pharmacopoeia expectations where applicable.
* Lead regulatory inspections and client audits, including inspection preparation, health-authority interactions, response strategy, remediation, and effectiveness monitoring.
* Maintain current knowledge of global regulatory requirements, industry trends, and best practices, and translate changes into timely updates to systems, procedures, and training.

Quality Assurance and Product Disposition
  
  

* Provide leadership and direction for QA oversight of manufacturing and laboratory operations, including batch record review, product disposition, quality events, and release decisions.
* Oversee review and approval of critical quality and technical documentation and ensure quality decisions are scientifically sound, risk-based, timely, and well documented.
* Facilitate quality risk assessments and mitigation plans to anticipate and address potential product, process, compliance, and supply risks.

Quality Control and Laboratory Governance
  
  

* Ensure Quality Control laboratories are appropriately equipped, staffed, and governed to support in-process, release, stability, and other required testing.
* Oversee analytical method development, qualification/validation, transfer, lifecycle management, laboratory investigations, and data integrity controls.
* Use laboratory and environmental monitoring trends, KPIs, and leading indicators to inform risk management, resource allocation, and improvement priorities.

Supplier, Material, and Client Quality
  
  

* Oversee supplier qualification, material quality, quality agreements, and the quality governance of raw materials and components used in manufacturing.
* Lead quality-related client communications, support client governance, participate in audits, and ensure observations and commitments are addressed effectively.
* Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders while protecting compliance, product quality, patient safety, and client satisfaction.

Operational Excellence and Cross-functional Partnership
  
  

* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across Quality operations using data, trends, metrics, and appropriate problem-solving methodologies.
* Partner with Manufacturing, R&D, CMC, Clinical, Engineering, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions to resolve complex quality issues and sustain compliant operations.
* Provide cross-functional support to ensure the sustainability and continual improvement of quality and compliance systems across the organization.

People, Organization, and Financial Leadership
  
  

* Build, recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing, diverse Quality organization with clear accountabilities, succession plans, and capability-development priorities.
* Manage the employee lifecycle for direct reports, including selection, hiring, onboarding, goal setting, coaching, development, performance discussions, and recognition.
* Establish meaningful quality performance metrics and regularly evaluate organizational effectiveness, capacity, and capability against business needs.
* Prepare and manage the Quality budget and expenditures, and support capital expenditure requests for quality, laboratory, site improvement, and renovation needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biological Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* At least 15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including at least 10 years in Quality leadership or Quality management roles.
* Extensive experience in a GMP-regulated biopharmaceutical, biologics, or CDMO environment; experience with antibody-drug conjugates is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated commercial manufacturing experience and broad knowledge of R&D QA, GLP, Clinical, CMC, Manufacturing QA, and QC environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional Quality organizations in complex, multi-site, or international settings.
* Deep knowledge of global GxP regulations, Quality Management Systems, regulatory inspections, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience interacting directly with regulatory authorities, clients, auditors, and strategic partners.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale programs, organizational change, quality improvement initiatives, and inspection remediation.

Leadership Competencies and Skills
  
  

* Strategic and systems thinking with the ability to connect quality risk, regulatory expectations, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Strong people leadership, organization-building, coaching, succession planning, and change-management capability.
* Excellent communication, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills at executive, client, and regulatory levels.
* Strong analytical, statistical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills for complex and ambiguous quality issues.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality culture, data integrity, scientific rigor, patient safety, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to operate effectively across cultures, functions, sites, and global time zones.

Physical and Travel Requirements
  
  
The role may require occasional domestic and international travel to support client meetings, regulatory inspections, conferences, partner interactions, and oversight of external or multi-site quality activities.
  
  
Role Success Measures
  
  

* An effective, sustainable, and inspection-ready Quality Management System.
* Consistent regulatory compliance and timely closure of audit, inspection, and quality commitments.
* Robust product disposition, laboratory, supplier, and quality-event governance.
* Data-driven continuous improvement and measurable reduction of recurring quality risks.
* A capable, engaged, and accountable Quality organization aligned with U.S. and global business needs.
* Strong, transparent, and trusted relationships with clients, regulators, partners, and internal stakeholders.

**The salary range for this position is $193,000 - $329,000**

Shape the future of quality and patient trust. Join us as the Vice President, Global Quality Control and lead a world-class laboratory network that powers our clinical and commercial programs across the globe. Reporting to the Chief Quality Officer, you will set the enterprise strategy and build a unified, high-performing Quality Control organization that delivers reliable data, inspection-ready laboratories, and timely product release support—while advancing standardization, digital innovation, scientific excellence, and operational performance.
  
  
**Company Overview**
The work we do at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies has never been more important—and we are looking for talented candidates to join us. We are growing our locations, our capabilities, and our teams, and looking for passionate, mission-driven people like you who want to make a real difference in people’s lives.
  
  
Join FUJIFILM Biotechnologies and help make the next vaccine, cure, or gene therapy in partnership with some of the most innovative biopharma companies across the globe. We are proud to cultivate a culture that will fuel your passion, energy, and drive - what we call Genki.
  
  
Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers
  
  
**Job Description**
Your impact In this enterprise role, your leadership will directly influence patient safety, product quality, inspection outcomes, batch disposition timelines, and continuity of supply across a diverse global portfolio. You will advise senior executives on investment, capacity, technology, organizational design, and regulatory strategy—shaping multi‑year business and quality plans. Your decisions will strengthen client trust, accelerate revenue recognition, reduce the cost of quality, and protect the company’s license to operate.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Define and execute a global Quality Control strategy, operating model, and multi‑year roadmap across sites, modalities, and development phases. Establish enterprise standards, clear decision rights, and governance forums that enable consistent, phase‑appropriate control while allowing justified site or platform differences.
* Provide executive oversight of end‑to‑end Quality Control operations, including analytical, biochemical, biological, microbiological, raw‑material, in‑process, release, and stability testing; as well as environmental and utility monitoring. Ensure capacity, prioritization, and flawless execution to meet program milestones, product disposition, client commitments, and uninterrupted supply.
* Govern the analytical method lifecycle from early development through transfer, qualification, validation, comparability, continued performance verification, and retirement. Ensure control strategies and specifications evolve appropriately through clinical development, process performance qualification, launch, and sustained commercial supply.
* Set global expectations for current good manufacturing practice, applicable good laboratory practice principles, data governance, principles that ensure data are attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, accurate and complete, laboratory investigations, out of specification and out of trend management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, change control, and audit readiness. Lead enterprise strategy and executive response for regulatory inspections and critical client audits.
* Build and deliver the digital and technology roadmap for laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, laboratory execution systems, chromatography data systems, laboratory automation, advanced analytics, and instrument connectivity. Sponsor validated deployment, master‑data governance, cybersecurity, and adoption that improve right‑first‑time outcomes and cycle time.
* Direct enterprise Quality Control capacity planning, capital prioritization, make‑versus‑buy decisions, laboratory footprint strategy, and governance of external testing partners. Align resources and contingency plans with demand forecasts, technology transfers, new product introductions, and network resiliency needs.
* Establish enterprise metrics and management review for on‑time testing and release support, lead time, invalid results, out of specification and out of trend rates, investigation cycle time, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, stability execution, method performance, cost, and productivity. Drive risk‑based priorities, Lean practices, and cross‑site learning to deliver sustainable improvement.
* Serve as the senior Quality Control liaison for strategic clients, regulatory authorities, and executive governance. Translate complex laboratory, method, and compliance risks into clear business implications, negotiate technically sound solutions, and ensure commitments are realistic, documented, and delivered.
* Build and lead a global organization through senior leaders. Define capabilities and succession plans, develop technical career paths and communities of practice, and cultivate a culture of scientific rigor, transparency, accountability, inclusion, and proactive risk management.
* Own escalation and coordinated response for significant Quality Control events, laboratory constraints, critical data‑integrity concerns, assay failures, method or specification issues, and testing disruptions. Make or recommend risk‑based decisions on testing strategy, product impact, remediation, and continuity of supply.
* Perform other duties in support of the broader Global Quality strategy and company objectives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with fifteen or more years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract development and manufacturing organization Quality Control; or a Master’s degree with ten or more years.
* Ten or more years of people leadership, including five or more years leading senior leaders with accountability for multiple laboratories, sites, or functional areas.
* Demonstrated leadership of Quality Control across development and commercial stages, including method transfer, qualification and validation, release and stability testing, microbiology, and environmental and utility monitoring.
* Proven experience with global regulatory inspections and client audits, and with complex out of specification, out of trend, data‑integrity, and laboratory‑compliance matters.
* Experience managing budgets, capital portfolios, headcount, capacity, external laboratories, and enterprise transformation in a matrixed global organization.
* Executive‑level communication and client‑facing experience in a regulated, technically complex environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced scientific degree and/or a Master of Business Administration.
* Global leadership within a contract development and manufacturing organization supporting biologics, vaccines, advanced therapies, or sterile manufacturing.
* Experience scaling Quality Control from clinical development through process performance qualification, launch, and sustained commercial supply.
* Working knowledge of the following: Food and Drug Administration; European Medicines Agency; Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency; Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency; International Council for Harmonisation guidelines Q2, Q5, Q6, Q9, Q10, and Q14; United States Pharmacopeia; European Pharmacopoeia; Japanese Pharmacopoeia; Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations Parts 210, 211, and 11; and European Union Good Manufacturing Practice Annexes 1 and 11; as well as applicable data‑integrity expectations.
* Experience deploying global laboratory information management systems and laboratory digitalization and automation.
* Credentials from the American Society for Quality, and training in Lean and Six Sigma or equivalent quality and operational excellence disciplines.

If you are a strategic, hands‑on executive who thrives at the intersection of science, operations, and leadership, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and help us raise the bar for quality worldwide.

existing_roles.description:
**MISSION**

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The VP, Global GMP Quality position will be responsible for leading the GMP quality functional teams at Mirum and its subsidiaries (US and International). This position will play a pivotal role in steering the organization toward an ongoing commitment to quality improvement, driving efforts to identify areas for optimization, innovation, and excellence. This person will be responsible for managing, mentoring and supporting a GMP Operations team of clinical and commercial Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) professionals. This person will provide leadership and hands-on support to ensure the seamless execution of GMP QA and QC functions, including product quality complaint investigation, root-cause investigations, and the reporting of critical GMP issues to executive management.  This person will also be responsible for leading, providing direction, resources, and guidance to ensure that all GMP quality processes are executed with the highest standards of compliance with FDA, EMA, and other international regulatory requirements, corporate objectives, and industry best practices. This role also involves ensuring that the GMP and GDP quality functions are closely aligned with the organization’s broader strategic goals, guaranteeing that quality initiatives support the company’s mission, vision, and operational objectives.

**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader to assist the head of quality to further develop the quality culture at Mirum to be compliant, collaborative and phase appropriate.
* Develop and execute a global GMP quality strategy to align with corporate goals and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader within the Quality group to lead the GMP QA and QC functional teams in fostering professional development and guiding staff in all aspects of GMP/GDP competence in meeting domestic and international regulatory requirements and guidelines (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, ICH, etc.).
* Lead the development and optimization of key processes, functional collaboration, transformational initiatives, and operational excellence through the GMP/GDP Quality Unit.
* Serve as the GMP quality lead in Audits and Regulatory Inspections in providing strategic leadership, interactions, responses, CAPA plans and implementation.
* Lead the GMP inspection readiness for the Company including GMP Quality improvement and maintenance.
* Host/Manage GMP PAI/PLI inspections at Mirum and support Mirum PAI/PLI related CMO inspections.
* Drive corporate values, vision, goals, and objectives through collaboration with senior leaders building cross-functional networks to influence operational capabilities.
* Serve as a GMP Quality advisor to cross-functional stakeholders within Mirum global organizations and subsidiaries.
* Promote collaboration across internal and external functional teams and stakeholders to identify, design and implement opportunities for improvement across all areas of GMP and GDP quality responsibilities.
* Establish, maintain, and ensure effectiveness of GMP and GDP quality programs and documentation to assure GxP compliance in the domestic and international regulatory environment.
* Oversee, support and perform all aspects of GMP QA and QC activities and functions for drug manufacturing to ensure product quality and supply chain integrity.
* Oversee and support all aspects of clinical and commercial product release which includes direct to market, partner and distributor.
* Serve as the Material Review Board (MRB) chair-person designee.
* Develop and execute a global recall strategy that integrates domestic and international recalls.
* Serve as the Recall Coordinator in the recall committee and support the recall/mock recall process.
* Collaborate with Commercial Organization on launch strategies, NPP/EAP/CUP programs and provide input as a Quality SME.
* Review and approval of GMP, GDP, Partner and Distributor Quality/Technical Agreements.
* Oversee the review and approval of APQR generation in a timely fashion.
* Assess the outcome of GMP audits at CMOs, CTLs, Partners, etc. for a holistic view and to partner with the Technical Operations team in driving improvements.
* Provide strategic and managerial leadership related to company objectives & initiatives and changing regulatory requirements to build, manage, and mentor high-performance QA and QC teams in a global environment.
* Oversee product launch, manufacturing, and distribution quality processes.
* Lead a culture of quality excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Ensure global GMP Quality Team meets stakeholder needs, focusing on efficiency, quality, budget management, and corporate growth.
* Serve as Quality Head designee for other GXP areas beyond GMP and GDP as required.
* Requires 15% domestic and international travel, at minimum.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education /Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, biology, or other science related field (Advanced degree preferred).
* 15+ years of progressive Quality Assurance experience in pharmaceutical and/or Biotech industries, with at least 10+ years in quality leadership role and/or people management including direct & indirect reports.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of cGMP manufacturing and Quality Management in compliance with FDA (CBER and/or CDER) and EMA requirements for global-regulated products.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of the development and commercialization of medical device in compliance with FDA 21CFR820, ISO13485 and EMA MDR regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO, ICH, and global regulatory requirements.
* Product lifecycle including Late-stage drug development, Regulatory (NDA, MAA, BLA, etc) submission and commercial manufacturing experience.
* Experience with hosting and preparing for inspection readiness and an ability to provide recommendations for its continuous improvement.
* Must be able to work cross functionally as a strong collaborator with ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders across multiple global regions.
* Experience with managing Product Quality Complaints and Pharmacovigilance Quality is a plus
* Experience in rare disease and/or biologics, a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Extensive hands-on experience in product lifecycle management including late-phase innovative drug development, medical device, combination product and global commercial launch with global CMC regulatory filings (IND/IMPD/CTA/NDA/BLA/MAA, etc.) in a multinational pharmaceutical organization.
* Demonstrate project and cross-functional team leadership, as well as people management skills across different cultures.
* Thorough understanding and working experience in innovative drug development and manufacturing of drugs and biologics concerning GMP operations, quality systems, ICH guidelines, FDA, EMA, and associated international regulatory requirements.
* Extensive working experience with management and oversight of the analytical activities at CDMOs or CTLs with quality mind-set and leadership.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with strategic and sound technically driven decision-making ability.
* Highly effective and strong ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.
* Strong sense of ethics and honesty.
* Ability to communicate with all levels of management and peers within the organization.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills.

The salary range for this position is $320,000 to $340,000 USD. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to; skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location. Please note that the required compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits unless otherwise provided.

! The VP, Quality & Regulatory is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the organization's enterprise-wide quality, regulatory affairs, and compliance programs. existing_roles.description:
**About This Role**
The Head of Corporate Quality is responsible for creating and managing the Global Biogen Quality Management System (QMS). The main areas of focus include Quality Systems, internal and external audits for cGMP compliance (including external vendors and CMOs), IT Quality, Technical Product Complaints, and Central Knowledge Management (including documentation).
  
  
This role is central to Quality and PO&T, managing risk, compliance performance, staying compliant with regulatory changes, and seeking opportunities to gain efficiency and effectiveness in the administration of PO&T’s cGMP systems. Additionally, the role is accountable for preparing semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS and informing Executive Management of potential business risks due to a changing regulatory environment or systemic issues within the company. This role also serves as the principal liaison with the R&D Clinical Compliance organization and provides guidance for ICH conformance. Oversight includes biologic products, ASOs, small molecule products, gene therapy, devices, digital, and combination products.
  
  
*This role is hybrid- RTP or hybrid- Cambridge based.*
**Travel requirements**
: 25% – 50% depending on location. More travel required if not located in RTP.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Implement integrated quality systems, policies, and standards applicable to all Biogen U.S. and international manufacturing sites and PO&T locations, including Baar, Cambridge, Netherlands, Solothurn, and RTP.
* Develop and maintain a risk assessment process for evaluating and monitoring all cGXP systems.
* Ensure regulatory inspection responses are assessed holistically.
* Establish clear goals and effective metrics that provide insight into industry benchmarks and applicable trends regarding cGMP compliance.
* Oversee external monitoring of regulatory updates (domestic and international) and incorporate changes into Biogen’s QMS as needed.
* Internal and external GxP and ISO audit programs, including risk management and audit program oversight.
* Ensure Biogen’s internal manufacturing sites, Quality Systems, and vendors operate in a state of cGMP compliance, with any risks appropriately communicated and escalated.

**IT QA Department**

* Oversee GxP IT computerized systems across Biogen, including underlying infrastructure.
* Define appropriate standards and manage lifecycle documentation and supporting processes to ensure compliant implementation and management through retirement.

**Lifecycle Management**

* Oversee process and compliance-related content (specifically documentation, including governing policies, process documents, and other similar GxP documents) in the electronic document management system.
* Protect, index, classify, and archive GXP records, digitally preserve vital records, manage records lifecycle, and translate GMP content needed in multiple languages.
* Oversee the PO&T training program, providing global guidance and standards to ensure appropriate GxP training is conducted.

**Technical Product Complaint Department**

* Develop and maintain policies and procedures to manage complaints in line with industry and regulatory standards.
* Identify strategy and provide direction to team members regarding complaint investigation, root cause analysis, CAPAs, regulatory responses, and launch readiness for new products.
* Ensure trending and reporting of complaint cases and metrics, including appropriate escalation and response to significant events.

**Global Management Review (GMR)**

* Act as the chair for the GMR, ensuring ongoing management review and awareness of Biogen Quality and compliance performance (in accordance with cGMP and ICH expectations).
* Prepare semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS based on GMR outcomes.
* Establish short and long-term goals, objectives, and strategies for the Global Corporate Quality organization.
* Ensure appropriate policies and procedures are in place to measure, monitor, and report "actual" versus "planned" results.
* Drive major projects and programs for the Organizational Unit or Function to completion within schedule and budget.

The Global Head of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of ProSciento's global Quality department, establishing the strategy, direction, governance, and priorities for the function. This role will oversee the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensures the organization maintains the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and inspection readiness.

  

This role is accountable for establishing and advancing the company's quality strategy, Quality by Design and governance framework, and quality culture while ensuring compliance with applicable GxP regulations, FDA requirements, ISO standards, and other country specific, regional, and international regulatory requirements. The Global Head of Quality partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, risk management, and organizational effectiveness while supporting ProSciento's strategic growth. Performs duties in accordance with ProSciento's values, policies, and procedures. Approximately 20% domestic and international travel is expected, with additional travel required based on business needs.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

  
* Provides strategic leadership for ProSciento’s Quality department, establishing the vision, priorities, and organizational structure to support the company’s operations and business objectives.
  
* Accountable for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations including GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), FDA, ISO, data privacy requirements, and other local, national, and international requirements.
  
* Responsible to oversee the quality of Global CRO studies and local site CRU trials as well as hands on experience implementing and maintaining a strategic Quality by Design framework for both business units.
  
* Responsible for the definition, development, implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of quality systems, processes, and Key Quality indicators (KQIs) to drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  

  

  
* Oversees the Quality Event Management program, including deviations, CAPAs, change control, investigations, risk assessments, and process improvement initiatives. Chairs or delegates the CAPA Board and ensures timely resolution of quality issues.
  
* Directs internal, external, sponsor, vendor, and regulatory inspection readiness activities, including audit planning, execution, response management, and corrective action oversight.
  
* Partners with Vendor Management to oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits, performance monitoring, and quality risk mitigation.
  
* Leads Executive Quality Management Reviews, ensuring quality trends, compliance risks, audit outcomes, CAPAs, and quality metrics are routinely communicated to Executive Leadership with appropriate recommendations and mitigation strategies.
  
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and governance of Quality Management System documentation, including quality policies, SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training programs, equipment records, and electronic document management systems.
  
* Partners with Information Technology and business leaders to ensure computerized systems, electronic records, and applicable equipment are appropriately qualified, verified, or validated in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  
* Establishes and promotes a culture of quality throughout the organization by providing strategic guidance, regulatory interpretation, and quality leadership across all functional departments.
  
* Maintains current knowledge of evolving global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices, ensuring organizational policies and procedures remain compliant and effective.
  
* Builds, develops, and leads a high-performing Quality organization by fostering employee development, succession planning, collaboration, accountability, and a culture aligned with ProSciento's core values.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Provides leadership and oversight for the Quality organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, recruitment, employee development, performance management, succession planning, coaching, and employee engagement.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the CRO or clinical research industry, including at least 5 years in senior quality leadership roles with responsibility for organizational quality strategy and personnel management with a minimum of 3 years of Global experience.
  
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

  

  
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems and quality governance, with demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality systems within clinical research and regulated environments.
  
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA regulations, ICH Guidelines, GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), ISO 9001, data integrity, and applicable privacy requirements. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) supporting GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP) environments and clinical research operations.
  
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor and internal audits, supplier qualification programs, CAPA governance, inspection readiness, and enterprise quality risk management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing quality organizations, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
